title: refactor: simplify operations dashboards
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes unused KPI API clients and overview/week-selector components.
- Removes the unused KPI GitHub App authentication path and keeps the active token flow.
- Collapses Model Monitor's duplicate polling effects and interval ref into one owned refresh lifecycle.
- Removes 278 net lines across the two operations dashboards; supersedes #12919 and #12976.

Checks:
- Biome on all surviving changed source files
- KPI production build and Worker dry-run
- Model Monitor production build on the absorbed commit
- `git diff --check`

gist.headline: Dashboard shed gets pruned
gist.blurb: A few dashboard branches had stopped bearing fruit, so they were composted. The remaining monitor refresh loop now has one gardener instead of several.
gist.summary: Removed unused KPI API clients, overview and week-selector UI, and the inactive GitHub App auth path while consolidating Model Monitor polling into one owned refresh lifecycle.
gist.impact: Operations maintainers get smaller KPI and Model Monitor codebases, with the active token flow preserved and duplicate polling state removed.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tidying a cozy operations garden: she prunes a few clearly dead dashboard branches while a single healthy retro monitor waters one thriving code-plant. This represents removing unused KPI UI and authentication paths while giving Model Monitor one clear refresh lifecycle.
